_meta.description: VANILLA Morrowind service-NPC index parsed from the game ESMs: every NPC offering barter, training, spells, spellmaking, enchanting, or repair — with location, faction, barter gold, and (where stored in data) top-3 training skills. VANILLA BASELINE ONLY.

conventions.vanilla_baseline: Shipped-game data. The server can add, move, or retune any NPC (gold, stock, services); captured NP differences belong in an np_override field per record (none recorded yet) — until then, answer with the vanilla value labeled as baseline.
conventions.trainer_top3: Populated only when the NPC's skills are stored in data (non-autocalc). null means the game derives them at runtime — not derivable offline (populated-or-null rule).
conventions.creatures: Merchant CREATURES (Creeper, the Mudcrab Merchant) are not NPC records and are not in this file; their existence is noted in strategy contexts elsewhere.

s-esm.note: NPC_/CLAS/FACT/CELL records parsed from local Morrowind/Tribunal/Bloodmoon ESMs.
